authority: Navigation map of existing clauses; not a replacement parser or a conformance profile.

phases.title: Decode prefixes and honor payloads
phases.constraint: An active payload does not grant its host a missing prefix. A quote needs a marker or an eligible claim.

phases.title: Classify comments
phases.constraint: After payload and prefix handling, classify comments only in a context available to admit them; an item lacking a prefix, claim or retained ownership ends before classifying a below-column comment in its enclosing context.

phases.title: Select the surviving owner
phases.constraint: Classify candidate openers for claim eligibility, then select ownership before accepting a block or lazy fold.

phases.title: Establish the authored block base
phases.constraint: Only a recognized opener can establish a base in its selected owner; ordinary over-indented text cannot.

phases.title: Consume the block or attachment extent
phases.constraint: Closed leaves and containing frames have separate lifetimes. Attachment consumes one complete block; its first-block form is limited to list items and definition descriptions.

phases.title: Update paragraph state and stored ownership
phases.constraint: Container survival, paragraph openness and ordinary-line claims remain separate facts.

evidence.projection: Reviewed HTML bytes; these fixtures do not prove invisible AST ownership or arbitrary-depth equivalence.
